7.headline: Sunbelt Motors decline rate rising; LTV exceeds policy limits
bullets: Decline rate increased from 32.0% to 38.9% year-over-year, reaching 41.8% in the last 3 months.
Average used-vehicle LTV jumped to 138.6% in the last 3 months, well above the 120% policy line, with LTV being the top decline reason (776 applications).
Ben Castillo should meet with Sunbelt Motors to review their pricing and trade-in valuation practices to bring LTV back within policy limits.

21.headline: Bluewater Motor Co. exceeds target with improving credit performance
bullets: Decline rate dropped from 31.8% to 23.3% in last 3 months; first-payment default improved from 2.6% to 1.4%
Dealer likely submitting stronger credit applications with better debt-to-income and credit score profiles
Grace Huang should recognize Bluewater's performance and explore capacity for additional volume growth

23.headline: Harbor Pre-Owned first-payment defaults jumped to 22.9% in 2026
bullets: First-payment default rate surged from 1.3% (Jan-Sep 2025) to 22.9% (Jan-Sep 2026), far exceeding the 1.7% book average.
The spike likely stems from weaker borrower quality or dealer practices, as LTV remains stable and decline rates have actually improved recently.
Hannah Cole should conduct an on-site visit to review Harbor Pre-Owned's customer verification and income documentation processes.

30.headline: Sunrise Motor Co. exceeds target with strong credit performance
bullets: Funded units averaged 27.7 per month in the last 3 months, exceeding the 23-unit monthly target, while decline rate improved from 32.4% to 30.2%.
Used-vehicle LTV increased from 106.7% to 110.1% in the last 3 months, suggesting customers are financing higher loan amounts relative to vehicle values while staying well below the 120% policy line.

Marcus Lee should discuss strategies to maintain the strong 0.4% first-payment default rate and explore opportunities to further reduce the 30.8% decline rate through credit score or DTI improvements.
